The fitting procedure is a multi-objective minimization using punishment functions to simultaneously match multiple experimental properties and the universal scaling curve. Translating the equations into a working energy/force code and setting up the fitting requires genuine understanding of the potential and optimization methods, not just a library call.

This requires building crystal structures, applying strains, handling periodic boundary conditions, and constructing slab geometries—a multi‑stage orchestration well beyond simple sequential steps.
